# Outrun

> Breakaway neon strokes for Resolume

Neon synthwave strokes as one FFGL effect with two engines. One traces the clip's
outlines as glowing tubes that can break away from the geometry underneath. The other
makes synthwave paths from scratch: the perspective grid with the striped sun, tunnels,
circuits, skylines, and the routed audio as an oscilloscope.

This page, https://outrun.stoatworks-labs.com/: The Outrun FFGL plugin's stroke pipeline running live in WebGL2: trace your webcam's outlines in neon, or generate synthwave grids, tunnels and circuits.
